title: Augmented strict restriction descent before mate identification
statement: Fix independent site and coefficient universes, a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], an open immersion j:U→X and the actual section-normalized operations o [def-sf-integral-open-operations]. Fix SU and SX in [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], and a generator-normalized ordinary extension tensor comparison tensor. There exists a natural isomorphism s:star⋙SU.reduction≅SX.reduction⋙P such that every flat-term K-flat complex Q on X [def-pc-kflat-complex] restricts to a flat-term K-flat complex and admits simultaneous strict quotient presentations on X and U, both with their scalar-unit augmentations. One strict chain isomorphism from the U presentation to the restriction of the X presentation localizes to s on Q; its finite degree components are the actual finite-adjunction unit/inverse-tensor/counit word. No extension comparison r, completeness, boundedness or quasi-compactness is assumed. This statement constructs the comparison but does not identify it with any derived adjunction mate.

proof.text: Choose the existing ordinary quotient/limit models on X and U. For each specified calculus, apply fixedDerivedComparison with the canonical constant-limit unit. Its comparison is invertible on good complexes and satisfies the finite presentation equations. The existing ordinaryAugmentedPresentation calculation gives the strict scalar-unit augmentation without a CoefficientDerivedSystemCoherence hypothesis.

Restrict the full category of good complexes using preservation under the prescribed open restriction. Extend the ordinary quotient restriction isomorphism degreewise to obtain a natural chain isomorphism; its degreewise finite components are the stated ordinary finite-adjunction word.

Conjugate the localized chain isomorphism by the augmented computation isomorphisms and the exact-functor localization factors. Use the localization of good complexes and Localization.liftNatIso to descend to s on the ordinary derived categories. Its component equation follows from liftNatTrans_app. Cancel the two computation inverses to obtain exactly the representative square. The finite formula is the ordinary formula in each degree.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YY, 0941 and 0GL1; B7 implements the augmented computation and localization steps, isolating ordinary quotient restriction and preservation of good complexes.

theorem openRestrictionAugmentedDescent
    (tensor : TensorComparison l E j o) :
    ∃ s : star l E j o ⋙ SU.reduction ≅ SX.reduction ⋙ P l E j o,
      (∀ (Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E X) ℤ)
    (hQ : integralOperationsGoodComplex l E X Q),
    ∃ (hRes : integralOperationsGoodComplex l E U
        (((restriction l E j o).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
      (CX : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E X) ℤ)
      (CU : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E U) ℤ)
      (eX : SX.reduction.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj CX)
      (eU : SU.reduction.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((restriction l E j o).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj CU)
      (κX : ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj CX ≅
          ((scalarReductionExtension l E X n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
      (κU : ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E U n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj CU ≅
          ((scalarReductionExtension l E U n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
            (((restriction l E j o).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
      (f : CU ≅ ((systemRestriction l E j o).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj CX),
      CoefficientReductionPresentation l E X SX.toCoefficientDerivedSystemReduction
        Q hQ.1 CX eX κX ∧
      AugmentedPresentation l E X SX Q CX eX κX ∧
      CoefficientReductionPresentation l E U SU.toCoefficientDerivedSystemReduction
        (((restriction l E j o).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) hRes.1 CU eU κU ∧
      AugmentedPresentation l E U SU
        (((restriction l E j o).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) CU eU κU ∧
      (SU.reduction.map ((restriction l E j o).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app Q) ≫
        eU.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f.hom =
      s.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫ (P l E j o).map eX.hom ≫
        (systemRestriction l E j o).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app CX) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ),
        (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E U n).map (f.hom.f i) ≫
          ((o.finite n).unitIso.app _ ≪≫
    (o.finite n).inverse.mapIso
      ((o.transportEvaluation n).app ((systemRestriction l E j o).obj (CX.X i))).symm ≪≫
    (o.finite n).inverse.mapIso
      ((SemilinearSections.evaluation.{t+1, t, max u (t+1)}
        ((ProEt.topology X).over (openObject j))
        (fun k ↦ (rings l E X k).over (openObject j))
        (fun k ↦ ((ProEt.topology X).overPullback CommRingCat.{max u (t+1)}
          (openObject j)).map (transitions l E X k)) n).mapIso
        (o.systems.counitIso.app _)) ≪≫
    (o.finite n).inverse.mapIso ((o.openSystems.restrictionEvaluation n).app (CX.X i))).hom ≫
          (finiteRestriction l E j o n).map ((κX n).hom.f i) =
        (κU n).hom.f i ≫ (((o.finite n).toAdjunction.comp
          (SheafOfModules.localizedSystemAdjunction.{t+1, t, max u (t+1)}
            (rings l E X n) (openObject j))).unit.app _ ≫
    (finiteRestriction l E j o n).map
      ((tensor.ordinary n).inv.app ((restriction l E j o).obj (Q.X i))) ≫
    (finiteRestriction l E j o n).map
      ((scalarReductionExtension l E X n).map
        ((ordinaryAdjunction l E j o).counit.app (Q.X i))))))
